name: Exact Document Context Match Word Count Step
overview: Tallies word counts for the text units whose leveraged top match was categorised as `EXACT_DOCUMENT_CONTEXT` — an exact match that originates from a repeated segment elsewhere in the same document (an internal repetition rather than a previous-version match; compare `EXACT_PREVIOUS_VERSION`). It reads the `AltTranslationsAnnotation` left by a leveraging step and, for each target segment or text container whose highest-ranked match is of this type, counts the words in the corresponding source. The counts are stored as `EXACT_DOCUMENT_CONTEXT` metrics annotations on the segment, text container, and aggregate resources, and consumed downstream by the Scoping Report Step. This is the word-count variant; the character-count variant counts characters instead of words.
processingNotes: Operates on the categorised top match only — the first entry of each segment's `AltTranslationsAnnotation` must have match type `EXACT_DOCUMENT_CONTEXT`.
Counts are computed over the source content; only translatable text units are counted.
Where a category group ranks several matches, the `CategoryResolver` keeps only the highest-ranked category and removes lower-ranked overlapping counts so totals are not double-counted.
